CREATE TABLE dbo.customer_final
(
    customer_id       VARCHAR(50),
    first_name        VARCHAR(100),
    last_name         VARCHAR(100),
    email             VARCHAR(255),
    phone             VARCHAR(50),
    age               INT,
    gender            VARCHAR(20),
    city              VARCHAR(100),
    state             VARCHAR(100),
    country           VARCHAR(100),
    signup_date       DATETIME2,
    customer_segment  VARCHAR(50),
    annual_income     DECIMAL(18,2),
    total_spend       DECIMAL(18,2),
    total_orders      INT,
    is_active         BIT
)
WITH
(
    DISTRIBUTION = ROUND_ROBIN,
    HEAP
);







CREATE PROCEDURE dbo.usp_load_customer_final
AS
BEGIN

    -- Remove previous data
    TRUNCATE TABLE dbo.customer_final;

    -- Load data from staging into final table
    INSERT INTO dbo.customer_final
    (
        customer_id,
        first_name,
        last_name,
        email,
        phone,
        age,
        gender,
        city,
        state,
        country,
        signup_date,
        customer_segment,
        annual_income,
        total_spend,
        total_orders,
        is_active
    )
    SELECT
        customer_id,
        first_name,
        last_name,
        email,
        phone,
        age,
        gender,
        city,
        state,
        country,
        signup_date,
        customer_segment,
        annual_income,
        total_spend,
        total_orders,
        is_active
    FROM dbo.stg_customer_cleaned;


END;





EXEC dbo.usp_load_customer_final;

SELECT COUNT(*) AS total_records
FROM dbo.customer_final;


SELECT TOP 10 *
FROM dbo.customer_final;
